name: Grantier
bio: Grantier was the Northern Pacific's carpenter foreman at Medora, and in August 1884 he built a large platform and derrick at the new warehouse for Black Hills freight. In September 1884 he finished an office and baggage room there for the Medora Stage and Forwarding company.
